## 6000 - 6032

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="06000">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />6000 Meter master analysis comparisons differences</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="06000">

Meter master analysis (MMA) exceptions are related to the master data validation for meter analysis configured in the Master Analysis form. MMA validation defines how a meter’s analysis data should look when brought in from the field.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="06001">

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="06001">

</div>
